query:
SELECT COUNT(*)                                             AS "listed!: i64",
                   COALESCE(SUM(detail IS NOT NULL), 0)                 AS "read!: i64",
                   COALESCE(SUM(detail IS NULL AND not_served_at IS NOT NULL), 0)
                                                                        AS "not_served!: i64"
              FROM peloton_class
